title: All 32 Montana proposal projects now have distinct reader dossiers
summary: Twenty-seven individually authored project accounts complete the retained 32-project Montana cohort. The initial five records remain exact. A dedicated index and searchable catalog expose each project, with separate terrestrial/LEO reporting designations, an anchor-only cohort and precise operator/entity relationships. This does not complete the wider 100-project or 70-place targets.
evidence_note: Each account is bound to exact retained project, subgrantee and deployment-reconciliation rows. No fresh external retrieval is claimed. Planned funding, estimated dates, raw technology/type codes, tribal flags and consent-name fields remain distinct from executed agreements, permissions, construction, testing, accepted service and observed adoption. The two Ziply entities have different UEIs; shared operator UEIs do not merge other projects. Hill-2 retains zero BSL rows, 21 anchor rows and an empty technology list.
publication_effect: Local content completion and owner-authorized AI review only. All operating-observation arrays remain empty. No human review, measurement admission, publishing permission, deployment or launch is created.
